title: Top-dimensional lattice cubes in ℝ^n: shape, volume, diameter and a.e. partition
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → (∀ (F : LatticeFaceIndex (m + 1) (m + 1)) (j : Fin (m + 1)), F.2 j = j) ∧ (∀ F : LatticeFaceIndex (m + 1) (m + 1), latticeFace ρ F = {x : Eucl (m + 1) | ∀ i, ρ * (F.1 i : ℝ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ ρ * ((F.1 i : ℝ) + 1)}) ∧ (∀ F : LatticeFaceIndex (m + 1) (m + 1), MeasurableSet (latticeFace ρ F)) ∧ (∀ F : LatticeFaceIndex (m + 1) (m + 1), volume (latticeFace ρ F) = ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ (m + 1))) ∧ (∀ F : LatticeFaceIndex (m + 1) (m + 1), ∀ x ∈ latticeFace ρ F, ∀ y ∈ latticeFace ρ F, dist x y ≤ Real.sqrt ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ρ) ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl (m + 1))), ∀ (i : Fin (m + 1)) (k : ℤ), x i ≠ ρ * k) ∧ (∀ g : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ≥0∞, ∫⁻ x, g x = ∑' F : LatticeFaceIndex (m + 1) (m + 1), ∫⁻ x in latticeFace ρ F, g x) ∧ ∀ f : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ, Integrable f → ∫ x, f x = ∑' F : LatticeFaceIndex (m + 1) (m + 1), ∫ x in latticeFace ρ F, f x
